representativeSnapshot.kind: isolated Supabase environment with the existing agent identity directory and no child-agent credentials

rowCountQueries: Select the ten target slugs from public.agent_identities before apply
Count public.agent_credentials and inspect agent_identities RLS and grants before apply
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: At most ten additive pending directory rows; existing slugs remain unchanged and no credentials, memberships, or privileges are created

execution.resumeStrategy: Reapply the idempotent INSERT in an isolated environment; use a later additive migration for corrections
execution.idempotency: INSERT uses ON CONFLICT (slug) DO NOTHING and never overwrites an existing identity

quarantine.strategy: No user or tenant data is transformed; every inserted principal remains pending

constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Apply twice in isolation; verify exact pending rows and hierarchy metadata, unchanged RLS and grants, and zero new credentials or application permissions

recovery.rollback: Leave the additive pending directory rows disabled; do not delete identities or reset a persistent database
recovery.forwardFix: Correct metadata or directory entries with a later additive migration after reviewing any provisioned linkage

queries: Verify the seven specialists, two managers, and Events principal exist once and remain pending
Verify reports_to, kind, execution_policy, and informational scope metadata match the registry
Verify no matching agent_credentials, organization memberships, or platform capability grants were created
Verify agent identity RLS and grants are unchanged
